title: crepis crocea var. czuensis
intro: Crepis crocea var. czuensis, commonly known as the Cezu Hawk's-beard or a type of hawk's beard, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Crepis crocea var. czuensis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
